proposal: The Mandate recommends that the DNI be clarified as the enterprise leader of the intelligence community's open-source collection and analysis, noting that open-source work remains disaggregated. status_summary: The House intelligence committee passed its FY2026 intelligence authorization bill on 2025-09-10, and Federal News Network reported that the bill would have the DNI establish an official to oversee open-source intelligence across the IC and minimize duplicative open-source activities and funding; industry groups urged the committees' leaders on 2025-10-24 to keep these measures, and the Senate version did not contain them. Division F of Public Law 119-60 (signed 2025-12-18), the enacted FY2026 intelligence authorization, has no open-source section in its table of contents, and its text read through Sec. 6703 does not mention open-source intelligence. ODNI's August 2025 reorganization fact sheet does not mention open-source intelligence, and no designation of the Principal Deputy DNI as chair of the National Open Source Committee was found. A Federal News Network report from July 2026 said the House committee's FY2027 bill again contains open-source provisions, on budget reporting and sharing across the IC, which are not enacted.
